ActionTriggeredEvent.description: Fires when a matching `SessionEvent` is appended (§30.6.3 #3).
ActionTriggeredEvent.title: ActionTriggeredEvent

CallerFactChange.description: One fact's new caller-belief value inside a `MutateCallerBelief` effect (§10.11).
CallerFactChange.title: CallerFactChange

CallerFactSpec.description:
`caller_knowledge.facts[fact_id]` (§30.2).

`certainty` is deliberately *not* bounded here: §30.8 rule 9 owns the 0.0-1.0 range so that an
out-of-range value is reported as `R09` alongside every other violation of the same file.
CallerFactSpec.title: CallerFactSpec

CallerProfileSection.description:
`caller_profile` (§30.3): every `CallerProfile` field plus the scenario's `emotion_rules`.

See the HLD-gap note at the top of this module.
CallerProfileSection.title: CallerProfileSection

CardTimers.description:
The schema-2 scenario key `timers` (§70.3.4) — all in session (running) milliseconds.

Every key defaults when absent; rule R39 (`positive`, `accept < not_completed`) is enforced by
the field bounds and by `validate_scenario_version`.
CardTimers.title: CardTimers

Condition.description:
The closed `Condition` structure (§10.11).

Exactly one of the combinators (`all`, `any`, `not`) or leaves (`fact`, `resource`, `stage`,
`sim_time`, `action`) may be set on a given node. `not` is aliased to the field `not_` because
`not` is a Python keyword.
Condition.title: Condition

ConditionalEvent.description: Fires when `condition` holds, re-checked each tick after `check_after_ms` (§30.6.3 #2).
ConditionalEvent.title: ConditionalEvent

DisclosureFactSpec.description:
`disclosure_rules.facts[fact_id]` (§30.2).

`aliases_ru` and `categories` reach the interpreter LLM inside the fact catalog; values never
do (D10) — this model carries no value-bearing field at all.
DisclosureFactSpec.title: DisclosureFactSpec

EmotionRule.description: `trigger -> delta`, scenario data (D4); applied in scenario declaration order (§10.5).
EmotionRule.title: EmotionRule

EtaProfile.description: The five ETA inputs `ScenarioDefinedEta` reads verbatim (§10.7).
EtaProfile.title: EtaProfile

ExpectedResponse.description:
`expected_response` (§30.5).

`resolution_condition` is optional *in the model* so that its absence is reported as `R28`
together with every other violation, rather than as a bare pydantic "field required".
ExpectedResponse.title: ExpectedResponse

InterruptionCountTrigger.description: Fires once the trainee has interrupted the caller at least `at_least` times (§10.5).
InterruptionCountTrigger.title: InterruptionCountTrigger

MutateCallerBelief.description:
Applied only if the owning event has `caller_observable = true` (D7).

Dropped with no trace by `advance` (E6) when that flag is false; this model itself imposes no
such restriction — it only describes the shape.
MutateCallerBelief.title: MutateCallerBelief

PrefabHandoff.description:
`expected_response.prefab_handoff` (§30.5, D6).

Required for a `role_chain` that starts at DDS; deliberately imperfect where the exercise
wants it to be, so `card_values` is checked against `CARD_FIELDS` (rule 14) but never against
world truth.
PrefabHandoff.title: PrefabHandoff

ResourceSelector.description:
`{"resource_id": str} | {"capability": str} | {"service_type": str}` (§10.11).

Exactly one of the three keys, enforced the same way as `Condition` itself.
ResourceSelector.title: ResourceSelector

ResourceSpec.description:
One entry of `available_resources` (§30.4, SPEC §11).

The scenario-file shape of `EmergencyResource` (§10.7): no `current_status` (it comes from
`availability.initial_status` at instantiation time) and `resource_id` is the scenario-local
string key, not the runtime `ResourceId` UUID.
ResourceSpec.title: ResourceSpec

SeededRandomEvent.description: Draws from the session-seeded RNG every `check_every_ms` (§30.6.3 #4).
SeededRandomEvent.title: SeededRandomEvent

SessionVariants.description: The resolved, recorded variants of one session; immutable after creation (§70.2.2).
SessionVariants.title: SessionVariants

SimTimeTrigger.description: Fires once the simulation has reached at least `at_ms` (§10.5).
SimTimeTrigger.title: SimTimeTrigger

TimedEvent.description: Fires once the simulation clock passes `at_ms` (§30.6.3 #1).
TimedEvent.title: TimedEvent

VariantSupport.description:
What a scenario supports per switch.

Every tuple is non-empty and duplicate-free — rule R32 checks that, so that a violation is
reported with every other one instead of as a bare parse error.
VariantSupport.title: VariantSupport

description:
One immutable scenario version: the SPEC §4 top-level keys, plus `variants`,
`reference_pack` and `timers` from schema 2 (§10.15, §30.1, D14, D15, D18).
title: ScenarioVersion
